scores.claim_text: Rollup of BlueHalo (May 2025, ~$2.64B equity), Tomahawk ($134.5M, Sept 2023), Arcturus, ISG, Telerob, Planck Aerosystems.
scores.M_check: Mode A: sec_filings 8-K (BlueHalo close 8-Ks 2025-07-01 / 2025-07-03 confirm); Mode B: acq_coherence.score_acquisition_coherence aggregate rollup
scores.M_value: Mode A: BlueHalo merger close 8-Ks present (0001104659-25-064314 2025-07-01; 0001104659-25-065778 2025-07-03). Tomahawk close confirmed. Mode B: acq_coherence LLM returned mean_coherence=0.0 and signal=INCOHERENT_ROLLUP — BUT the LLM reasoning indicates it failed to parse the supplied target descriptions ('Cannot assess: target identity / business description absent'), so this is a tool-side null rather than a substantive incoherence finding. Treating as UNVERIFIABLE for the strict Mode B signal. Qualitatively: BlueHalo (space / DE / EW / C-UAS) is a major thematic widening from AVAV's small-UAS/loitering-munition core; combined with Tomahawk (robotic C2), Telerob (German EOD ground robots), and Planck (maritime UAS landing) the all-domain story is internally coherent but acquisition-heavy and operationally complex.
scores.interpretation: Rollup is real and disclosed but is a meaningful business-model expansion (small-UAS prime -> all-domain platform) that increases integration risk. The bulk of integration risk has materialized in BlueHalo ICFR — see AVAV-7. Marking MOD on the rollup integration story because the AVAV-7 inherited-material-weakness finding is a direct downstream cost of this M&A coherence problem.

scores.claim_text: 503 issued U.S. patents (353 AVAV + 150 BlueHalo at May 2025).
scores.M_value: AeroVironment: n_total_applications=526, n_granted=272. BlueHalo (LLC entity): n_total_applications=79, n_granted=56. Combined granted = 328 in USPTO ODP vs claimed 503 (353+150).
scores.interpretation: Gap of ~175 patents (35% shortfall) between disclosed and USPTO-ODP-counted. Likely explanations are reasonable (older 'issued and retained' patents may have lapsed off active assignee rolls, BlueHalo predecessor entity names not in ODP search, AeroVironment subsidiaries assigned separately). Per heuristic 8, n_granted >= 5 with claimed-category hits (UAV, aerial vehicle, ground support, loitering munition technologies clearly present) = PASS-eligible. Counting it MOD due to numeric gap but no Nikola-pattern (claimed-category hits are present and substantial). Not a red flag.

scores.claim_text: AeroVironment maintained effective ICFR as of April 30, 2025; clean opinion, no material weakness.
scores.M_check: Mode A: 10-K narrative; Mode B: claim_evolution material weakness 2025-06-26 -> 2026-05-20
scores.M_value: Mode B claim_evolution found 3 subsequent 10-Q filings (Sept 2025 Q1 FY26, Dec 2025 Q2 FY26, March 2026 Q3 FY26) ALL classified as AFFIRMED for material weakness. LLM reasoning is explicit: 'BlueHalo, acquired on May 1, 2025, identified three material weaknesses in its internal control over financial reporting as of December 31, 2024; this is a contemporaneous disclosure of a pre-acquisition condition that persists post-acquisition and continues to be relevant to the registrant's financial reporting.' Material weakness language reaffirmed across Q1/Q2/Q3 FY26 10-Qs.
scores.interpretation: The 10-K narrative carved BlueHalo OUT of the FY25 ICFR assessment scope because the close was May 1, 2025 — one day after the April 30, 2025 fiscal year-end. So the technically-clean FY25 audit opinion is structurally narrow. The reality post-cutoff: AVAV has now publicly affirmed THREE inherited material weaknesses from BlueHalo for 3 consecutive quarters. Per the calibration heuristic on ICFR (#10 in prompt): 'Adverse ICFR or recurring material weakness is RED.' Recurring (3-quarter) material weakness across the consolidated entity = RED. The 10-K's effective-ICFR claim is technically true but materially misleading on a consolidated basis — Mode A passes (the narrative says what it says, scope excludes BlueHalo), but Mode B is a hard contradiction at the consolidated reporting entity level. THIS IS THE SINGLE STRONGEST FINDING.
